action.objective: Verify Bxb4 as the top exact-scoring move while preserving the extra rook and passed pawns.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search gave a5b4 the only exact score (835), with a clean PV advancing the a-pawn. It wins a pawn, removes the b4 pawn, and keeps the rook on a4 active. Verification will check Black's immediate replies and short forcing lines before committing.
